summary: Provides filesystem infrastructure utilities including file I/O operations for text and JSON, file enumeration and search functionality, and file operation helpers for access checking and exclusive access handling.
responsibilities: Read and write text and JSON files with directory management and file deletion capabilities
Enumerate files and provide file search functionality based on filter conditions
Provide file operation helpers such as access checking and waiting for exclusive access
relationships: FileSearch uses filter conditions to provide search functionality
FileOperation provides access checking and waiting for exclusive access helpers
design_decisions: Normalizes line endings to LF when reading Python source files
